hard_class_invariants.description: Sealed analysis records are never mutated post-commit
AnalysisRecord IDs are deterministic SHA-256 hashes of content
Fitness adjustment deltas bounded to [-0.20, +0.20] per cycle
No signal emitted from sample size < 3 outcomes
Every analysis run logged in ledger regardless of outcome
Any analysis error yields NO_SIGNAL, never a partial record
Every AnalysisReport carries a SHA-256 content seal
AMPS base-weight recalibration requires HUMAN-0 authority
Signal emission blocked when CGDR gate reports DRIFTED or UNKNOWN
